purpose: Bind a frozen validity assessment and a contemplated human research action into one fail-closed packet for Discipline Engine eligibility evaluation without generating autonomous trading instructions.

binding_rules.evidence_strength_passthrough: The adapter must pass validity.evidence_strength to Discipline Engine unchanged.
binding_rules.validity_integrity_fail_closed: If all_required_dimensions_reported is false or post_outcome_rule_change_detected is true, risk-increasing actions must be evaluated with evidence_strength=INSUFFICIENT regardless of the reported strength; the original reported strength must remain auditable in adapter metadata.
binding_rules.hash_presence: evidence_artifact_sha256, validity_result_sha256 and pre_registration_sha256 must be non-empty lowercase 64-character SHA256 hex strings.
binding_rules.no_risk_field_inference: The adapter may not invent, default, optimize or estimate missing risk fields. Missing required fields are an error.
binding_rules.no_action_substitution: The adapter may not change BUY to ADD, HOLD to EXIT, or otherwise rewrite action_type.
binding_rules.no_position_optimization: The adapter may not calculate an alternative position size or risk budget to rescue an otherwise blocked action.
binding_rules.override_passthrough: Override intent and reason are passed unchanged and can never convert a blocked eligibility result into eligible.
binding_rules.fail_closed: Malformed, incomplete or semantically inconsistent packets do not receive ACTION_ELIGIBLE.

non_goals: No conversion of research uncertainty into action eligibility
